components.css: .ds-sample{display:inline-flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--rule,#615743);min-height:2.75rem;padding:0 .85rem;color:var(--ink,#ece5d4);font-family:Arial,"Noto Sans SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}.ds-sample>span{font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--muted,#b6ac98)}.ds-sample select{border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--ground,#24231f);color:var(--ink,#ece5d4);font-family:Arial,"Noto Sans SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;min-width:10rem;max-width:100%;padding:.6rem 1rem .6rem 0;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-sample select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-hover,#df806f);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:45em){.ds-sample{min-width:0;gap:.5rem;padding:0 .6rem}.ds-sample>span{display:none}.ds-sample select{min-width:0;width:100%}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sample select{transition:none}}

components.name: Registered view tabs
components.description: Four equal columns with ruled dividers and an understated selected-view marker.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#615743);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#615743)}.ds-tabs button{position:relative;text-align:left;font-family:Alegreya,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.3125rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted,#b6ac98);padding:1rem 1.25rem 1rem 0;background:none;border:0;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-tabs button+button{padding-left:1.4rem;border-left:1px solid var(--soft-rule,#443e32)}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--ink,#ece5d4);background:#ffffff04}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink,#ece5d4)}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:0;width:2.6rem;height:2px;background:var(--accent,#ce6857)}.ds-tabs button+button[aria-selected=true]::after{left:1.4rem}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-hover,#df806f);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:45em){.ds-tabs button{font-size:1.0625rem;padding:.9rem .35rem .9rem 0}.ds-tabs button+button{padding-left:.65rem}.ds-tabs button+button[aria-selected=true]::after{left:.65rem}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]::after{width:1.8rem}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tabs button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
MoonAXML uses a continuous, ruled folio: warm charcoal supports ivory content, serif headings mark changes in reading context, and compact interface controls leave most of the page to the inspected artifact. The XML-bracket and binary-block mark is the identity asset.

The system is flat and restrained. Color marks actions, selection, and diagnostics; spacing and sepia rules organize information. English and Chinese share the same controls and reading hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark surfaces, ivory text, and sepia divisions.
Alegreya branding and headings; system sans-serif controls and monospaced data.
Square controls and one continuous result surface.
Fixed reading sizes with explicit responsive adjustments.

rules.name: The Restrained Scarlet Rule
rules.body: Use scarlet for actionable controls, selected-view markers, source links, focus, and diagnostics; keep long-form result data neutral.

rules.name: The Fixed Reading Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep data and control sizes tied to their reading role. Change layout before reducing the type scale.

rules.name: The Tonal Separation Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with the ground/plate relationship and one-pixel sepia rules; do not add raised card shadows.

dos: Do preserve the warm dark palette, the XML-bracket mark, and the serif/sans/mono role split.
Do keep source values readable with wrapping or a bounded local scroll area.
Do give each action a visible keyboard-focus treatment and an accurate state.
Do keep bilingual labels concise and allow long filenames and values to wrap.
donts: Don't apply scarlet to entire result sheets or add decorative surface effects.
Don't replace the continuous folio with nested cards or rounded promotional chips.
Don't imply resource resolution, Android defaults, uploads, or a security verdict.
Don't introduce decorative onboarding, invented evidence, or unverified deployment claims.
